dialogues.speaker: Guan Hong
dialogues.text: I'm fine, it's just that I was diagnosed with an incurable illness a while back. I was told that I didn't have long...

dialogues.speaker: Guan Hong
dialogues.text: So I asked myself, what have I done my entire life?

dialogues.speaker: Guan Hong
dialogues.text: I've worked hard, sacrificing my health, and what did I earn for it? A pile of things I wasn't born with, and can't take with me when I die.

dialogues.speaker: Guan Hong
dialogues.text: Looking back, I didn't do even one thing that I could be proud of in all those decades. Ha...

dialogues.speaker: Guan Hong
dialogues.text: It's a shame that I realized it so late.

dialogues.speaker: Guan Hong
dialogues.text: Yes, thank you. I need some time alone.

dialogues.speaker: Guan Hong
dialogues.text: Hahaha, are you here to have fun too?

dialogues.speaker: Guan Hong
dialogues.text: What am I doing? I'm enjoying life!

dialogues.speaker: Guan Hong
dialogues.text: I always thought that work was the most important thing. I slept little, ate little — got myself neither a wife nor kids!

dialogues.speaker: Guan Hong
dialogues.text: ...At least, that was until Dr. Baizhu told me I was a goner a little while back. That's when I figured it out! What work? What career? It's all hogwash!

dialogues.speaker: Guan Hong
dialogues.text: Good thing all the money I've saved in my earlier years is more than enough for me to wine and dine myself to death here at the Pearl Galley.

dialogues.speaker: Guan Hong
dialogues.text: ...Actually, when I put it like that, things aren't so bad! Hahaha!

dialogues.speaker: Guan Hong
dialogues.text: Hey now, don't be so quick to leave...
